description:
FILED s473t5b (Opus, 2026-09-13) by #1501 round 3 (op/ CHECK 2), which
attributed 318 blessed fail rows to it: t/op/gv.t 160 and t/uni/gv.t 138 (the
other 10+10 are the ruled warnings family #221), plus t/uni/gv.t's whole
118-row shortfall.  The two files are ONE family and were probed once
(scratch/s473t5b/probes/batt1.txt).

THE FAMILY, in four parts, each probed against perl 5.40.3:

(a) PROXY CONSTANT SUBROUTINES -- the biggest part, and the one the two files
    ABORT on.  In perl a stash slot holding a plain STRING is the sub's
    PROTOTYPE, and a slot holding a SCALAR REF is a constant sub:

      $::{oonk} = "pie";
      eval 'prototype \&oonk'     perl: "pie"     PCL: undef
      delete $::{oonk};
      $::{oonk} = \"Value";
      eval 'prototype \&oonk'     perl: ""        PCL: undef
      eval 'oonk'                 perl: "Value"   PCL: "oonk"  (the BAREWORD)
      *{"ga_shloip"} = \&{"oonk"};
      ref $::{oonk}               perl: SCALAR    PCL: ""
      ref $::{ga_shloip}          perl: SCALAR    PCL: CODE

    t/op/gv.t:580-586 is
        { die if exists $::{BONK}; $::{BONK} = \"powie";
          *{"BONK"} = \&{"BONK"};
          eval 'is(BONK(), "powie", "...(bug 45607)"); 1' or die $@; }
    and the `or die $@` FIRES in PCL, which is the file's blessed abort
    signature (`aborted-forms:4: Died at gv.t line N.`) and the reason 111 of
    its rows are `ok -> (missing)`.  uni/gv.t aborts in its own copy of the
    same block.  Rows: `String is promoted to prototype`, `Prototype for a
    constant subroutine is empty` (x4 / x9), `Value is correctly set`,
    `Constant has correct value`, `Correct type of value (...)`, `Symbol table
    has full typeglob`, `Export doesn't affect original`, `Export of proxy
    constant as is`, `Exported target is also a PCS`, `Inlining of constant
    doesn't change representation`, `const list ...` (4), `calling const list
    with &`, `stash elem is still array ref after use`.

(b) FAKE GLOBS / stash-entry IDENTITY.  A glob VALUE stored in a stash slot is
    perl's "fake" glob, and `*{"name"}` then returns THE SLOT:

      our $bar; $::{phake} = *bar;
      \$::{phake} == \*{"phake"}   perl: 1        PCL: 0
      ${\*{"phake"}} = undef;
      ref(\$::{phake})             perl: GLOB     PCL: SCALAR

    Rows: `symbolic *{} returns symtab entry when FAKE`, `compile-time *{}
    returns symtab entry when FAKE`, the two `no type coercion when assigning
    to retval of ... *{}` rows, `[perl #1804] *$x assignment when $x is FAKE`,
    `Can localize FAKE glob that's present in stash`, `Localized FAKE glob's
    value was correctly restored`.

(c) THE GLOB'S IO / FORMAT SLOTS, and printing THROUGH one.  `*x{FORMAT}` and
    `print {*x{IO}} "..."` -- gv.t's block at 172-189 produces TWO FEWER TAP
    rows in PCL than in perl, which is why the blessed rows 54/55
    (`*foo{NAME}` / `*foo{PACKAGE}`) are `(missing)` although those two slots
    THEMSELVES work (probed).  `ref *x{FORMAT}` and `*{*x{GLOB}}` are the
    named rows.

(d) THE ANONYMOUS IO GLOB'S NAME.  `my $io_ref = *STDOUT{IO}; my $glob =
    *$io_ref;` stringifies as `*__ANON__::__ANONIO__` in perl and as
    `GLOB(0x1)` in PCL (rows `RT #65582 anon glob ...`, 3 of them).

SIBLINGS, already filed, both narrower: #1117 (after `undef *GLOB` perl
REMOVES the aggregate slots; the fix shape needs vivify-on-read and is sized
there) and #1638 (a glob REF in container position is perl's fatal and the
glob-VALUE element path does not exist).  This task is the model question they
are both instances of, and #1117's USER decision (A)/(B) gates the same
representation choice.

WHY IT IS ONE TASK: every part above is "what a stash slot HOLDS decides what
the name MEANS".  PCL's stash is a hash of boxes and a sub is a CL function,
so a slot holding a string or a scalar ref cannot be a sub at all, and a slot
holding a glob value is not the same object as `*{"name"}`.

BAR: the four probe batteries above, then t/op/gv.t and t/uni/gv.t re-run and
their rows spliced with causes.  NOTE BEFORE MEASURING: t/op/gv.t is
ROWS-UNSTABLE on a loaded box -- #1651 -- and s473t5b measured it three ways
on one tree (67/24 at --timeout 90, 67/24 parallel at 420, **89/96 serially at
420**, blessed 135/56; the runner itself prints "THREE-WAY ... rows
unstable?").  The 89/96 run produced 185 TAP rows and stopped after perl's row
187 with NO error text, which is a different stop point from the blessed run's
(first missing row 194).  Measure this file ALONE on a quiet box.
subject: The TYPEGLOB MODEL: a stash slot holding a string is a PROTOTYPE and one holding a scalar ref is a CONSTANT SUB (perl's proxy constant subroutine), a glob VALUE in a slot IS *{name} (a FAKE glob), and *x{IO}/*x{FORMAT}/*$io_ref are missing -- 318 blessed rows of t/op/gv.t + t/uni/gv.t, and the abort both files take
